title: First instruments and teachers
summary: Starts on ukulele at 10-12, moves to banjo, takes lessons from Son Thomas and Walter Preston, plays with school and Spasm bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Did you tell us about your first instrument, what you started playing?
Well, I started to play in the ukulele. Ukulele.
Yeah, on the steps. How old were you then?
Well, I was around about 10 or 12 years old during that time. Then I picked up on a banjo. And I went to Son Thomas a little while. And then we started off in school. The Spasm Band.
Banjo with Kidman A. Oh yeah.
I heard the name. I didn't remember it wrong. Yes.

Uh huh. And I left him and I went to Walter Preston a little while. Then after I could play Pretty Fair, John Kazimer, well we all from the same neighborhood, played with him. I played with Kid Clayton. Then I left them and went to Biloxi with the Spasm Band. We stayed over there during the summertime.
